title: N-body problem
exact_target: Do almost all collision-free initial conditions of the Newtonian N-body problem generate solutions for all time? Determine the measure of the exceptional collision and noncollision singularities.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 4200002 (AMR-041-0002). CC BY 4.0.
